title: Crafty Table
description: Craft anything in a crafting table.
body:
Be able to craft **nearly anything**, including:
- Saddles
- Command blocks
- Chainmail armor
- Name tags
- Elytras
- Debug sticks
- Bells
- End portal frames
- Enchanted golden apples
- Totems of undying
- Barrier blocks
- Bedrock
- Player heads
- Tridents
- Mob spawners
- Trial Keys
- Ominous trial keys
- Trial spawners
- Vaults
- Reinforced deepslate
- Petrified oak slabs
